summary: Backend+frontend regression validation completed for notification/ringtone/chat stability batch. /ringtones notification mode correctly shows exactly two rows (Smilers Notification + Silent), chat tools button no longer breaks route stability, and /api/translate returned 200 quickly (~0.7s). Major code-review regressions remain in notification audio behavior and missed-call logic. MOCKED APIs: none.

ui_bugs.issue: Silent mode is not truly silent: hook always plays message_notification_beep before checking selected notification sound.

integration_issues.issue: Missed-call local notification can be incorrectly scheduled after answered calls because incomingCallSeenRef is set on incoming state and never reset on answer/active transition.

Runtime width check remained blocked in preview because /chat/testconversation1 resolves to conversation-unavailable state and attachment trigger is disabled; only code-review confirmation was possible.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warnings persist (expo-notifications web listener limits, expo-av deprecation, shadow/textShadow/pointerEvents deprecations).

action_items: Fix useMessageNotificationSound to skip all playback when notificationSound is silent (no beep fallback).
Fix missed-call notification condition by tracking answered state and resetting incomingCallSeenRef when call becomes active/answered.
Run signed-in native-device retest for voice-note recording, real incoming/background/killed-state ringing, message alerts, and missed-call delivery.
Run authenticated chat route retest to visually verify attachment-sheet thickness in active conversation state.
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/frontend/src/lib/notification/useMessageNotificationSound.ts`: `playSound()` unconditionally plays `message_notification_beep.mp3`, which violates Silent selection semantics.
`/app/frontend/app/call/[conversationId].tsx`: missed-call scheduling relies on `incomingCallSeenRef` but does not clear it on successful answer, allowing false missed-call notifications.
`/app/frontend/app/chat/[conversationId].tsx` remains very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk for composer/recording/translation side effects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified in preview: /ringtones notification tab has exactly 2 rows, chat tools button no longer route-crashes, and backend /api/translate responds quickly. Not yet conclusively validated: attachment-sheet thinner visual in authenticated chat, physical-device voice-note recording, and real background/killed-state push/ringing behavior.
rca_of_issue: RCA-1 (Silent not silent): In useMessageNotificationSound.playSound(), code always executes `playClip(message_notification_beep.mp3)` before checking selected follow-up tone, so selecting Silent still produces audible beep. RCA-2 (false missed call): call screen sets incomingCallSeenRef=true when isIncoming; when user answers and call later ends, ref may still be true and effect schedules missed-call notification despite answered call.
